text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main tasks is text understanding, which means a computer can read a sentence and find its meaning. NLP also makes translation possible, so machines can change text from one language into another quickly. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions. Thanks to these tools, we can communicate with machines more easily than ever before.
